notes:
Luke 15:8-10. A parable, so a red-letter KJV inks the whole thing - including
the woman's own line inside it and Jesus's frame around her. j1 and j2 stay RED,
and two more verses of the same parable that the video only paraphrased are lifted
out and join them in red:
  jv8   Luke 15:8   'Either what woman having ten pieces of silver...'
  jv9a  Luke 15:9a  'And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her
        neighbours together, saying,' - Jesus's own frame inside the parable, and
        it sits on the beat immediately before j1, the line it introduces.
NOTE: the woman in this parable is NOT a `woman` beat. She is a character Jesus
invented inside a story he is telling; the words are his, and a red-letter Bible
prints them red. Pink is for women the Bible records actually speaking.
This build had NO closing-card narration - the card was silent text on cream. A
`card` segment is added carrying the card's existing words, so the card is spoken
like every other build in the library and TAIL can be derived from it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When Jesus wanted to show how God feels about one lost soul, he didn't talk about crowds. He told this story.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A woman has ten coins. She loses one.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She lights a lamp. She sweeps the whole house.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She searches carefully — not casually, carefully — until she finds it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying,

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then she calls her neighbors and friends to celebrate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One coin. Out of ten. The joy is disproportionate to the value of the coin.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Over one. Not a crowd. One.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Have you ever felt like the thing that got lost, rather than the one doing the searching?
